data.name: VoxMancer
data.detailed_description:
VoxMancer is a voice-driven 3D magic action game where spoken words become real in-game spells.

Magic should not feel like choosing from a menu.

Instead of relying only on hotkeys, you speak your spells out loud. Say what you want, shape it with your words, and cast it into battle against other spellcasters.

Want a simple fireball? Say it.

Want it faster, larger, piercing, homing, or completely ridiculous? Try it.

Shout with the same passion you had as a kid, or chant like the legendary spellcasters you grew up watching in fantasy films, anime, and games.

For certain signature spells, the longer and more dramatic the invocation, the more powerful and spectacular the magic becomes.

Cast in the language that feels most natural to you.

Say it. Shape it. Cast it.

Your Voice Is Your Spellbook

Remember shouting made-up attacks with your friends as a kid and wishing they could actually happen?

VoxMancer turns that childhood fantasy into magical combat.

The fun is not only in casting a powerful spell. It is in saying the spell out loud, committing to the ridiculous phrase, and letting everyone hear it happen.

A duel can feel serious one second and completely chaotic the next. One player might deliver the perfect invocation and unleash a devastating attack. Another might panic, say something absurd, and trigger a magical failure that blows up in their face.

Every fight becomes a mix of imagination, timing, pressure, and chaos. You are not simply memorizing a fixed list of abilities. You are deciding what to say in the moment, shaping the spell through language, and dealing with whatever happens next.

Some spells are simple.

Some spells are powerful.

Some spells are ridiculous.

Some spells fail spectacularly.

Your voice is your spellbook.

Your imagination is the weapon.

Key Features

Voice-Driven Spellcasting

Cast magic by speaking naturally. Say the spell you want instead of selecting every ability from a rigid hotbar. Cast in the language that feels most natural to you.

Shape Spells With Your Words

Modify spells through language. Make them faster, larger, piercing, homing, rapid-fire and more.

Dramatic Invocation Casting

Short calls are perfect for fast combat. For certain signature spells, longer and more theatrical invocations can unleash greater magical power and spectacle.

Magical Duels Built Around Speech

Battle other spellcasters in fights where what you say matters—and where everyone can hear the spell you dared to cast.

Imagination-Driven Combat

Combat is not only about reflexes. It is about choosing the right spell idea, saying it under pressure, and watching your words become magic.

Elemental Spell Foundations

Begin with elemental magic, then reshape it through spoken modifiers, combinations, and different styles of casting.

Multilingual Voice Spell Input

VoxMancer is designed to support voice spell input across multiple languages, allowing players to cast using spoken commands in the language they are most comfortable with.

Ultimate Magical Spectacle

Unleash devastating signature attacks, strange surprises, hidden spells, and over-the-top magical outcomes that make battles exciting to play and fun to watch.

Magical Failure Feedback

Not every idea will work exactly the way you expect. When the magic fails, it fails with style.

data.short_description: VoxMancer is a voice-driven 3D magic PvP game where players shout their own incantations in battle. Magic is imagination made real: invoke elemental and arcane forces, shape magic with your words, and unleash dramatic, ridiculous, or panicked ideas as powerful spells or spectacular misfires.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700 / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
